new_value: {"notes":"2026-08-27 completed against spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.2 and draft-lichen-link-01. Bit 5 is S and bit 7 is SI. The canonical matrix is exhaustive: 00 unsigned/no SIID accepted and round-tripped; 11 signed/exactly 8-byte SIID accepted and round-tripped; 10 S-only rejected; 01 SI-only rejected. Existing Zephyr, Python, and Rust codecs agree on those semantics and the current C Schnorr verifier also rejects both mismatches before transcript authentication. Canonical corpora cover every address mode, both accepted MIC selector values, maximum payload boundaries, all 8 signed frames, every authenticated transcript field, and malformed flags. Added the remaining explicit atomicity evidence only: Zephyr parser leaves its destination struct unchanged and serializer leaves its output buffer unchanged for both mismatch directions; Python serializer rejects both invalid model shapes before producing bytes; Rust writer rejects both shapes without changing the caller buffer. No implementation or spec drift was found. Validation: Apple clang ASan+UBSan strict frame suite 18/18; standalone C frame ctest 1/1; C Schnorr interop ctest 1/1 and 8/8 cross-language signed vectors; Python focused frame/signed/security 161 passed, 10 platform skips plus ruff clean; Rust lichen-link frame/lib 30/30 and shared vectors 8/8, cargo fmt check clean; the immediately preceding unchanged production implementation passed local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 link_crypto 18/18. No shared-worktree collision."}
